statement: The unchanged movielens-lagrange-service-affinity-live scenario reports priority metric 0 on one fresh run, and every zero-change deterministic replica-operation INSERT collision is accepted only after the canonical replica_operations partition leader confirms the matching durable row, with leader-pin intent preserved through the control-plane gateway.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, retry duration, operation deadlines, concurrency budgets, or live scenario semantics.

A zero-change replica-operation INSERT is success only when a read pinned to the canonical replica_operations partition leader returns the same operation identity and required content; missing, mismatched, failed, or deferred confirmation remains fail-closed.

Preserve an explicit preferOwnerRpcReadLeader request through the canonical gateway without changing the default routing of generic owner-RPC repair reads or turning SQL/cache visibility into leader authority.
Do not raise retry or visibility budgets and do not add a cache, table, retry loop, or parallel authority; close the existing caller-to-gateway-to-owner-RPC option path.

Before another live run, prove red on current HEAD and green on the fix for both the collision caller's leader-pin request and the real gateway's preservation of that request into owner-RPC execution, while a leader-missing row and content mismatch still fail.
